text:
marta: Hey — saw alerts for increased `ws.chunk_latency` and ~10 disconnects overnight. Can someone point me to where to grab a couple of sample traces + the raw WS logs? Need to hand off to infra oncall. cc @kai @josh

josh: For traces check the traces tab in APM: https://apm.redwood.example/traces?service=streaming - search `span.name:ws.write` and timeframe `2026-03-16T22:00..2026-03-17T06:00`. For logs use Loki: `{job="streaming-gateway"}` filter `partial_frame`.

kai: If you want a quick log query in Loki use:
```
{job="streaming-gateway"} |= "partial_frame" | logfmt | line_format "ts=" + ts + " id=" + trace_id
```
That will give trace ids we can open in APM.

marta: awesome. josh — any dashboard link for chunk timing distribution? The alert fired on 95th pct > 350ms.

josh: Yep: https://grafana.redwood.example/d/abc123/streaming-latency?orgId=1&from=now-8h&to=now
Panel: `ws.chunk_latency` histogram. You can also add `region` and `model` filters.

observability-bot: nightly-ingest job completed: 2026-03-17 03:15 UTC — 3 errors, 8 retries, 12 disconnects

kai: Suggestion: bump alert to 500ms for night window and add a rate condition `>=5 disconnects / 10m` so we don't spam overnight. Also add `service.version` tag to the metric to see if rollout caused it.

devon: I pulled one sample trace id: `7a9c2fefb3d4` — found within APM and it shows a long `ws.write` span waiting on `kv-cache` miss. Pasting the tail of the log:
```
[03:41:02] INFO stream_id=7a9c2fefb3d4 event=chunk_send duration_ms=420 partial_frame=true
[03:41:02] WARN stream_id=7a9c2fefb3d4 upstream=kp-01 retry=1
```

marta: perfect — i'm dropping these into the infra ticket. Can someone run a quick canary with cache warmup tomorrow morning and ping here when done? @kai

kai: will do. scheduling a small 10-rps canary at 09:00 UTC with `--warmup-prefix-cache` flag. I'll post results.

marta: thx all :thumbsup:
